rubric.decided: 2026-10-02, by the person, after rounds 2 and 3: the person's own grades are the standard
rubric.meaning: relevant means PLAUSIBLY CONNECTED to the subject, as the person grades it
rubric.2: something on the card -- a stated topic, a paper title, a role -- sits in the search's subject area or a close neighbour
rubric.1: the subject shows only as skill tags (e.g. Stack Overflow tags), with no papers, role or bio
rubric.0: nothing on the card is in the subject's area, or the card is empty
rubric.derived_from: the person's 14 grades in calibration rounds 2 and 3; the rule reproduces all 14, but was fitted to them, so that is not validation

superseded.work_shows_it: the 2026-10-02 'the work shows it' rubric, under which round 3 did not pass

rubric.what_it_measures: plausibility of a match, not demonstrated expertise: close to what judgments.json's criteria already score
